Package com.egradx.audit.query

Class EgradxAuditQueries

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.audit.query.EgradxAuditQueries
public class EgradxAuditQueries extends Object
Reads the audit trail: search, one record, one thing's history, and a stream for exports. Newest first throughout, paged by cursor.

Names of people and organizations are looked up as records are read, through the EgradxAuditNameResolver — never stored.
